title: Control of representation updating by higher-order thalamus enables history-based decision-making
primary_outputs: Recompute common-versus-rare context information in trial-by-unit firing data.
Compare neural context coding under pulvinar suppression and TRN activation, retaining experiment and subject identities.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_bridge: Figure3 archive includes RData firing-rate workspaces and R analyses. Inspected 3C/3G code pivots raw_pred_db fields t_num, context, laser_block, spk.st and uuid_tb into trial×unit predictors.
